items.title: Inventory related governance documents and current baseline context
items.context: Read existing decision documents for unattended completion, mid-flight story repair, three-round two-host review escalation, and baseline execution so the new document follows established Lattice conventions.

happy.desc: The resulting roadmap document includes a visible Source And Context Mapping section that inventories all CHK-001 related governance documents and current baseline context, and maps each source to concrete roadmap decisions or sections.

edge.desc: The inventory distinguishes overlapping or potentially conflicting governance concepts such as unattended completion, mid-flight repair, 3-round 2-host escalation, baseline PASS suites, and negative-control BLOCKED suites instead of flattening them into vague citations.

adversarial.desc: A skeptical reader can trace every major source-derived claim in the new document back to the mapping, with no invented runtime behavior, no direct story or fixture file edits, and no missing required source document from the checklist.

items.title: Write the milestone execution plan for the three strengthening tracks
items.context: Create a detailed requirements decision document that decomposes hard scope boundaries, mechanical evidence chain, and collaboration/preflight controls into executable milestones with deliverables, gates, tests, and sequencing.

items.title: Verify the document is auditable and does not overclaim implementation
items.context: Review the new document for clear non-goals, milestone DONE criteria, 3-round 2-host decision-doc validation policy, baseline/negative-control expectations, and explicit statement that it is a plan rather than completed runtime behavior.
